metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Calendar'[Year])), 'Calendar'[Year] >= 2022)

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
		__DS0FilterTable,
		"MinYear", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Calendar'[Year]))),
		"MaxYear", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MAX('Calendar'[Year])))
	)

metrics.visualTitle: Total Revenue and Revenue 3M Moving Avg by Year and MonthYear

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Calendar'[Year],
			'Calendar'[MonthYear],
			'Calendar'[MonthYearSort],
			"Total_Revenue", '_Measures'[Total Revenue],
			"Revenue_3M_Moving_Avg", '_Measures'[Revenue 3M Moving Avg]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'Calendar'[Year], 1, 'Calendar'[MonthYearSort], 1, 'Calendar'[MonthYear], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Calendar'[Year], 'Calendar'[MonthYearSort], 'Calendar'[MonthYear]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		VALUES('dim_accounts'[region])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(101, __DS0Core, 'dim_accounts'[region], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'dim_accounts'[region]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"Revenue_YoY__", '_Measures'[Revenue YoY %]
)

	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

	"Win_Rate", '_Measures'[Win Rate]

	ROW(

)

EVALUATE
	ROW(

)

)
